treatment_design: complete paired 2 predictor-stack x 4 risk-policy x 2 target-style block within every init

outcome_definitions.fixed_geometry_adjusted_delay_s: ego completion time minus target exit time from the route-projected conflict zone; ego and target route points are logged by the controller, required to agree across treatments within 0.001 m for each init, and use a frozen 4.0 m radius
outcome_definitions.raw_completion_time_s: scenario completion duration from the rollout metric pipeline
outcome_definitions.minimum_footprint_separation_m: minimum oriented-rectangle separation with the frozen logged 0.25 m per-actor inflation
outcome_definitions.native_collision: CARLA collision-sensor event taxonomy, reported separately from footprint overlap
outcome_definitions.yield_failure: target does not clear the fixed route-geometry conflict zone before ego entry under the frozen 0.2 s tolerance
outcome_definitions.completion_failure: the frozen post-CARLA completion rule is false

headline_hypotheses.statement: B1 task adaptation improves held-out in-distribution give-way prediction relative to frozen B0 and simple physical/route-prior baselines.
headline_hypotheses.r3_role: not retested; use frozen E1/E4 offline and in-loop prediction evidence

headline_hypotheses.statement: Replacing the matched MLP residual adapter with the lightweight Transformer residual adapter yields consistent gains in both output-parameterisation pairs.
headline_hypotheses.r3_role: not retested; use frozen E3 model-fairness evidence
primary_contrasts: T1 minus B2-M test macro NLL
T2 minus B2-D test macro NLL

headline_hypotheses.statement: The offline advantage of the B1 predictor stack translates into a stable closed-loop benefit across all prespecified risk-policy and target-style cells.
headline_hypotheses.treatment_minus_control: B1 minus B0 within each risk-policy x target-style x init block
headline_hypotheses.support_rule: stable translation requires non-positive mean delay and non-negative mean separation in every one of the eight policy-style cells, with no excess native collision, yield failure or completion failure; otherwise universal stability is not supported

headline_hypotheses.statement: The frozen adaptive policy stack empirically dominates each of the three prespecified fixed policy stacks.
headline_hypotheses.treatment_minus_control: adaptive minus each fixed comparator, evaluated separately within predictor stack and target style
headline_hypotheses.dominance_rule: adaptive dominates a fixed comparator only if mean delay is no greater and mean separation is no smaller, at least one inequality is strict, and adaptive has no excess native collision, yield failure or completion failure
headline_hypotheses.universal_support_rule: H4 requires dominance over all three fixed comparators in every predictor-stack x target-style stratum
sensitivity: outcome-dependent conflict-point delay retained only as sensitivity

inference.raw_display: all five init-level paired effects plus arithmetic mean and median
inference.exact_test: two-sided sign-flip test over five init-cluster effects
inference.multiplicity: Holm adjustment within each declared contrast family
inference.missingness: report missing/excluded clusters; complete-case n=4 has minimum nonzero two-sided exact p=0.125; never silently impute or drop
inference.equivalence_rule: p greater than 0.05 is not evidence of equivalence

families.H3: eight policy-style B1-minus-B0 contrasts per primary outcome
families.H4: three adaptive-minus-fixed contrasts within each predictor-style stratum per primary outcome

prohibitions: Do not pool legacy and corrected rollouts.
Do not use R2 pilot values for effect estimation.
Do not change primary outcomes, directions, dominance rule or families after R3 outcomes are read.
Do not call zero observed collision proof of safety.
Do not attribute B1 versus B0 solely to model weights because calibration also differs.
Do not call three fixed settings a complete theoretical frontier.
